evals.prompt: Check my FORAN environment and tell me if the launcher and Python dependencies are ready.
evals.expected_output: Runs `foran env check` and `foran selftest`; reports install_dir, launcher, license_file status and any missing GUI dependencies without modifying project data.

evals.prompt: Generate a hull with Lpp=150 m, B=22 m, T=8 m, D=12 m, Cb=0.78, including lines drawing and hydrostatics.
evals.expected_output: Runs `foran hull gen --lpp 150 --breadth 22 --draught 8 --depth 12 --cb 0.78 --brep`; writes sections.json, lines.svg, hydro.json, report.md and hull.brep; achieved Cb within tolerance.

evals.prompt: Put this lines DXF on an A1 sheet with a title block and save it as framed.dxf.
evals.expected_output: Runs `foran dxf frame --in lines.dxf --out framed.dxf --sheet A1 --fit --project ... --title ... --drawing-no ...`; output contains a border, title block and the original geometry.

evals.prompt: Read this FORAN loftbook .lis and export a 21-station offset table plus section-area curve.
evals.expected_output: Runs `foran offsets export --lis offsets.lis --out-prefix out/sample --stations 21`; writes CSV/XLSX table and SVG/PNG area curve; reports integrated volume.

evals.prompt: On a copy of my project database, create a closed box compartment 20x10x8 in the CARGO node and export the compartment list.
evals.expected_output: Runs `foran db copy` first, then `foran fga brep --box 20,10,8 --node CARGO` and `foran fga spaces`; TSV contains volume 1600.000 and correct COG/bbox.
